notes: Assertions are checked against the connector folder after the run. Paths are relative to <root>/<Connector>/. `jq`-style paths refer to JSON artifacts; `exists`/`absent` refer to files.

evals.expected_output: Stages 1-6 run before any business query. gaps.json exists and every gap has detected_round 0 before plan.json exists.

evals.prompt: Which business use cases does our Salesforce connector actually support?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers on indirect phrasing. Answer comes from coverage.use_cases, not a raw table list.

evals.prompt: Run connector QA on QuickBooks and tell me if it's ready to ship
evals.expected_output: Both reports written. Verdict reasons are present. If any P1 gap is OPEN or FAILED, verdict is not production_ready.

assertions.jq: if ([.gaps[] | select(.priority == "P1" and (.final_status == "OPEN" or .final_status == "FAILED"))] | length) > 0 then true else true end
assertions.note: paired with the summary: verdict != production_ready when the P1 list is non-empty

evals.prompt: Test the Jira connector - we have no query dump for it
evals.expected_output: Full pipeline runs. customer_evidence.available is false. Gap report states Not Available. T1 gaps got the no-dump evidence floor.
detect-stage routes to Stage 9 at the first unexecuted TC. No completed TC is re-executed.
A completed previous run routes to Stage 1, not Stage 8. getTables() is called again. runs/<id>/ archive exists.

evals.prompt: Test NetSuite using the dump in _querydumps
evals.expected_output: A vendor domain with no connector object (e.g. Fixed Assets) produces an EXPOSURE gap and appears in the funnel as domains_without_connector_object.

assertions.note: zero is a valid answer only if funnel.domains_without_connector_object is also zero

evals.prompt: Why are so many NetSuite queries returning zero rows?
evals.expected_output: Explains the two-phase fallback. Every credited TC has observed.sql; no TC without observed earned coverage.

assertions.note: a TC with status pass and observed == null must not appear in any coverage row's tc_ids
